summary: Session 2026-11-04 (pre-open). AMD reported after the Nov 3 close. Q3 beat, Q4 revenue guide about $17B vs $16.2-16.3B expected, gross margin guide 55% slightly below the 55.3% expected. AMD closed 483.90 and traded 518 after hours (+7%). That is positive for the semis group and should lift NVDA and AVGO at the open. I did not chase AMD after the gap because the beat is priced in and I have no edge on entry. Nov 3 close: NVDA +2.3%, AVGO +3.1%, MSFT +2.7%, META +2.4%, AMZN +2.1%, PLTR -1.65%, AAPL -1.9% (closed out at the stop; sold last session). QQQ +0.6% and XLK +1.3%, so the AI selloff looks to be stabilising. I held all positions: MSFT 13%, NVDA 12%, META 10%, AVGO 8%, PLTR 4.6%. Cash is about 52%. Stops: NVDA 193.7, AVGO 307.3, META 571.8, MSFT 483.6, PLTR 143. Next session: check whether the semis rebound holds. If it does, consider a modest AMD or GOOGL entry on a pullback, and consider deploying part of the cash given the large cash drag vs SPY. Check the midterm election result and macro.
